title: Personal Training Packages: how an active corporate wellness enrollment reduces a chargeable trainer-reassignment fee
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states how holding an active corporate wellness enrollment reduces a chargeable trainer-reassignment fee.

## Rule
A chargeable reassignment fee starts from the tier's own flat reassignment fee. Where the member holds an active corporate wellness enrollment, that enrollment's own employer discount percentage reduces the chargeable fee by that percentage in full; where no active corporate wellness enrollment is held, the full tier fee applies with no reduction.

## Points of judgement
- What is held: an active corporate wellness enrollment.
- What value it contributes: that enrollment's own employer discount percentage.
- What effect it has: it reduces the chargeable reassignment fee by the full percentage, proportionally; this reduction only ever applies to a reassignment that is already chargeable, never to one that falls within the tier's own free allowance.
As a hypothetical illustration only (not any tier's actual listed fee), suppose a tier's flat reassignment fee were 100.00 dollars and the linked active corporate wellness enrollment's own employer discount percentage were 25: the chargeable fee would be reduced by the full 25 percent, leaving a charge of 75.00 dollars. Where the member holds no active corporate wellness enrollment, the chargeable fee is the full tier fee with no reduction.
